interface.name: infinity_window_style_v1
interface.description: Malaysia rounds every window it composites (ADR 0059). As in macOS Tahoe, the corner radius depends on the window's bar. A client-decorated application uses this global to say which bar its toplevel draws. It grants nothing, so every client may bind it. Without it, the compositor picks the radius from the window's decoration and role.

enum.name: bar

description.summary: kind of bar a toplevel draws

enum.description: Each value matches an AppKit window kind and its corner radius.

entry.name: titlebar
entry.summary: a plain titlebar, as NSWindow without a toolbar

request.name: destroy
request.description: Bars already set stay in place.

request.name: set_bar
request.description: Tells the compositor which bar the toplevel whose wl_surface is given draws, so its frame gets that bar's corner from the next frame on. A later request replaces it. It lasts for the lifetime of the wl_surface.

request.name: set_popover

description.summary: the popup is a popover with an arrow

request.description: Tells the compositor that the xdg_popup whose wl_surface is given is a popover, as NSPopover. The top arrow-height logical pixels of its window geometry are the arrow band. The compositor shapes the body below that band with the popover corner, and joins to it an arrow that points up at the centre of the popup's anchor rectangle, clamped to the body. It lasts for the lifetime of the wl_surface.

enum.name: panel
enum.description: Each flag matches an AppKit NSPanel property.

entry.name: hides_on_deactivate
entry.summary: hidden while no toplevel of its client is active, as hidesOnDeactivate

entry.name: floating
entry.summary: stacked above every toplevel of its client, as isFloatingPanel

entry.name: key_only_if_needed
entry.summary: a press does not give it keyboard focus, as becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded

request.name: set_panel
request.description:
Tells the compositor that the xdg_toplevel whose wl_surface is given is a panel, as NSPanel. A panel never becomes its client's main window: while it holds keyboard focus, the client's last focused toplevel that is not a panel stays activated and remains the active window the shell shows.
With hides_on_deactivate, the compositor hides the panel while the active toplevel belongs to another client or there is none, and shows it again, at the same place and stacking, when one of its client's toplevels becomes active.
With floating, the panel stays above every toplevel of its client.
With key_only_if_needed, neither mapping nor a press on the panel moves keyboard focus to it. The client asks for focus when a press lands on a view that needs the keyboard, with an xdg_activation_v1 token made from that press.
Send it before the first commit with a buffer. A later request replaces the flags. It lasts for the lifetime of the wl_surface.
